Rural-based groups under Anakpawis hold a protest at the Suntay-owned Clean Fuel gasoline station in Cubao, Quezon City, as prices of oil and petroleum products are set to increase “big time” on Tuesday, March 10. 

Protesters denounced oil companies for allegedly exploiting tensions in the Middle East to manipulate pump prices in their favor. 

📸: Santi San Juan/MB
